input: Our bootloader doesn't recognize the new ARM C1 CPU cores — it falls back to generic ARMv9 code paths and skips per-core errata workarounds. The MIDR_EL1 values for C1-Ultra and C1-Nano are not in the BL31 CPU library. We're on TF-A 2.12 — do we need to upgrade to get C1 support, and what TF-A CPU ops need to be added?
